name: Disney's House of Mouse
description: A very-recognizable audience of Disney animated characters gather into the House of Mouse nightclub to enjoy musical guests, cartoon shorts and Master of Ceremonies Mickey Mouse's comical introductions from the stage.

videos.title: Mickey's Magical Christmas: Snowed in at the House of Mouse
videos.overview: Mickey's Magical Christmas: Snowed in at the House of Mouse is the first direct-to-video movie spin off from the Disney Channel animated television series Disney's House of Mouse.

videos.title: Mickey's House of Villains
videos.overview: The villains take over the House of Mouse on Halloween.

videos.title: The Stolen Cartoons
videos.overview:
As an attempt to end the show and shut down the House of Mouse, Pete steals all the cartoons. Meanwhile, Donald is put in charge of the club after Mickey  and Goofy  leave to film a new cartoon.

Cartoons: Pluto Gets the Paper (Wet Cement); Donald's Dynamite (Magic Act); Hickory Dickory Mickey

videos.title: Big Bad Wolf Daddy
videos.overview:
Donald hires the Big Bad Wolf and the Three Little Pigs to perform a show at the club, which Mickey fears since the wolf damaged the club the last time he performed.

Cartoons: Donald's Charmed Date; Pluto Gets the Paper (Mortimer); How to Be Groovy, Cool, And Fly

videos.title: The Three Caballeros
videos.overview:
The Three Caballeros are to perform at the club, but no-one knows that Donald was a Caballero, so he tries to be the most important performer of the group, re-naming himself "The Duck Formerly Known as Donald", an obvious parody of Prince.

Cartoons: Donald's Fish Fry; How to Be Smart

videos.title: Goofy's Valentine Date
videos.overview:
Minnie and Daisy develop sorrow for Goofy after finding out that he has no Valentine's Day date, so they set up a blind date for him.

Cartoons: Donald's Valentine Dollar; Mickey to the Rescue (Staircase); Pluto's Arrow Error

videos.title: Timon and Pumbaa
videos.overview:
Timon and Pumbaa are set to perform a show, but end their friendship after they decide that they can't make the same decisions, so Mickey decides to bring them back together.

Cartoons: Pluto's Magic Paws; Mickey to the Rescue (Cage and Cannon); Golf Nut Donald

videos.title: Jiminy Cricket
videos.overview:
Jiminy Cricket decides to stop his job as Pinocchio's conscience, and befriends Pain and Panic, soon realizing that Pinocchio and him must stay together after he becomes Mickey's conscience. When Pinocchio reunites with Jiminy, Pain and Panic begin to cry their hearts out, but then get turned into dirt by the Blue Fairy.

Cartoons: Mickey's Mistake; Daisy's Road Trip

videos.title: Unplugged Club
videos.overview:
Pete attempts to stop show performances again by removing the electrical battery and turning off all the club's electricity.

Cartoons: Music Store Donald; Mickey's Cabin

videos.title: Gone Goofy
videos.overview:
Goofy is fired from his job as the waiter after the club's budget causes problems.

Cartoons: Pit Crew; Goofy's Extreme Sports (Shark Feeding); Donald's Goofy World

videos.title: Rent Day
videos.overview:
Before the show ends, Mickey needs to pay the rent for Pete after he spends the money on cheese.

Cartoons: Mickey's Mountain; Maestro Minnie (Circus Symphony); Big House Mickey

videos.title: Donald's Lamp Trade
videos.overview:
Donald is convinced that Mickey is not his friend after Jafar tricks him into believing this, and must rescue the lamp for Jafar to prove that they are not friends.

Cartoons: Survival of the Woodchucks; Goofy's Radio

videos.title: Donald's Pumbaa Prank
videos.overview:
Pete tries to break Mickey and Donald's friendship apart by letting out a bad odor in the club made by Pumba.

Cartoons: Mickey's April Fools; Whitewater Donald

videos.title: Thanks to Minnie
videos.overview:
Minnie feels that she does not belong as a staff member of the House of Mouse, so she quits her job, realizing how much she means to the rest of the staff.

Cartoons: Minnie Visits Daisy; Mickey's Big Break

videos.title: Pluto Saves the Day
videos.overview:
Pluto has to save the club after Pete uses magical apples to shut down the club.

Cartoons: Goofy's Big Kitty; Pluto's Kittens

videos.title: Daisy's Debut
videos.overview:
Daisy is given a chance to perform a duet with Mickey at the club, which makes Minnie feel left out. Daisy fakes injuring herself, to give Minnie her role in the duet.

Cartoons: Daisy's Big Sale; Topsy Turvy Town

videos.title: Goofy for a Day
videos.overview:
Max thinks that Goofy's job is not as important as Mickey and Donald's, so Goofy challenges Max to be a waiter.

Cartoons: How to be a Waiter; Maestro Minnie (Hungarian Rhapsody #6); Donald's Dinner Date

videos.title: Clarabelle's Big Secret
videos.overview:
Clara poses a secret to get secrets about the members of the club.

Cartoons: How to be a Spy; Double Date Don

videos.title: The Mouse Who Came to Dinner
videos.overview:
Mickey and the gang pull out all the stops to please restaurant critic Mortimer Mouse.

Cartoons: Mickey's Mix-Up; Maestro Minnie (Flight of the Bumble Bee); Donald's Grizzley Guest

videos.title: Max's New Car
videos.overview:
Max wants to get a car, but Goofy feels that he is not ready for one yet. A living car from one of the cartoons shown at the club arrives and Max takes it, only to be driven around against his will.

Cartoons: Mickey's New Car; Carwashers

videos.title: Not So Goofy
videos.overview:
When Mickey and the gang get tired of Goofy's clumsiness, Goofy tries to become "un-Goofy."

Cartoons: Roller Coaster Painters; Goofy's Extreme Sports (Wakeboarding); How to Wash Dishes

videos.title: Everybody Loves Mickey
videos.overview:
Donald Duck feels unwanted when Mickey gets all the attention.

Cartoons: Mickey's Rival Returns; Mickey to the Rescue (Train Tracks); Donald's Failed Fourth

videos.title: Max's Embarrassing Date
videos.overview:
Max has a date with Roxanne at the House of Mouse. At Max's request, everyone tries their best to keep Goofy away as he is a constant source of embarrassment to him.

Cartoons: Pluto's Penthouse Sweet; How to Ride a Bike

videos.title: Where's Minnie?
videos.overview:
Minnie goes down to the prop basement to find Mickey a birthday present, but after realizing that she didn't take Pluto, Mickey thinks that she's lost and takes Pluto, Goofy and Donald with him to find her.

Cartoons: Mickey and the Color Caper; Donald's Pool

videos.title: Super Goof
videos.overview:
After eating some contaminated peanuts, Goofy becomes a superhero named Super Goof, which no one seems to know is him despite not wearing a mask or changing his voice. Now, he must save the club from an oncoming meteor.

Cartoons: How to Take Care of Your Yard; Locksmiths

videos.title: King Larry Swings In
videos.overview:
King Louie's brother Larry visits the House of Mouse and quickly wreaks havoc.

Cartoons: Mickey and the Seal; Goofy's Extreme Sports (Paracycling); How to be a Gentleman

videos.title: Ladies' Night
videos.overview:
Mickey leaves Minnie in charge of the House of Mouse while he, Donald and Goofy go bowling. Minnie, Daisy, and Clarabelle host Ladies' Night, but Mortimer is obsessed with being a part of the show.

Cartoons: Purple Pluto; Daisy Bothers Minnie; Maestro Minnie (William Tell Overture)

videos.title: Dennis the Duck
videos.overview:
Donald never thought that black and white cartoons were really too funny, but a new vintage character, a duck named Dennis, tries to win Donald over.

Cartoons: The Whoopee Party; Mickey and the Goat Man

videos.title: Suddenly Hades
videos.overview:
Pete breaks the club's air-conditioner on a very hot day and the only guest left is Hades. Now, Mickey and the gang must stop Pete from driving Hades away and shutting down the club.

Cartoons: Donald's Pool; Donald's Lighthouse

videos.title: House of Magic
videos.overview:
Daisy convinces Mickey to let her perform a magic act in the show, but makes the audience (and later the club, minus the screen) disappear.

Cartoons: Presto Pluto; Donald's Dynamite (Bowling); Babysitters

videos.title: Salute to Sports
videos.overview:
Donald tries to prove that he is a good sport by not losing his temper. Meanwhile, Goofy tries to sing the National Anthem, but keeps getting it wrong.

Cartoons: How to be a Baseball Fan; Goofy Gymnastics

videos.title: Mickey vs. Shelby
videos.overview:
Mrs. Turtle wants her baby son Shelby to perform, and Mickey agrees to babysit him. However, Shelby, always wanting to give constant headaches to those who are not his mother, drives Mickey insane and nearly gets him in trouble.

Cartoons: Shell Shots; Domesticated Donald

videos.title: Pete's One-Man Show
videos.overview:
Pete agrees to be nice if Mickey lets him perform, but nobody comes to see him. Now, they have to convince Pete that he's performing for a full house in order to keep him from shutting down the club.

Cartoons: Pinball Mickey; Von Drake's House of Genius (Time Reverser); Housesitters

videos.title: House of Crime
videos.overview:
A string of unexplained thefts and kidnappings occur at the club.

Cartoons: Mickey Foils the Phantom Blot; Von Drake's House of Genius (Teledinger)

videos.title: Mickey and Minnie's Big Vacation
videos.overview:
Mickey and Minnie try to leave for a vacation and leave Donald and Daisy in charge of the club.

Cartoons: Around the World in 80 Days;  Donald's Dynamite (Fishing)

videos.title: Donald and the Aracuan Bird
videos.overview:
The Aracuan bird visits the House of Mouse as the special guest of the evening. However, Donald is not too happy about it, and is being driven insane when he constantly gets blamed for the chaos the bird causes.

Cartoons: Pluto vs The Watchdog; Bird Brained Donald

videos.title: Goofy's Menu Magic
videos.overview:
Goofy takes over for Gus Goose as the club's head chef for one night but is a total disaster. After the Fairy Godmother accidentally leaves her wand with the dishes, Goofy uses its magic to make his meals taste delicious.

Cartoons: Sandwich Makers; Mickey Tries to Cook; Pluto Gets the Paper (Bubblegum)

videos.title: Music Day
videos.overview:
The Quackstreet Boys (Huey, Dewey, and Louie) have broken up and Mickey, Donald and Goofy have to reunite them in time for the show, even resorting to impersonating them and playing music terribly.

Cartoons: How to be a Rock Star; Goofy's Extreme Sports (Skating the Half Pipe); Donald's Rocket Ruckus

videos.title: House of Scrooge
videos.overview:
Scrooge thinks that their spending too much money at the House Of Mouse so he buys it and makes everything cheap but it`s ticking Mickey and the gang off so they try to get Scrooge to give back the House of Mouse.

Cartoons: Midsummer Night's Dream; Von Drake's House of Genius (Money Increaser)

videos.title: Donald Wants to Fly
videos.overview:
Despite the many characters who can fly, Donald wants to fly like them. He tries tips from the Notre Dame Gargoyles, Scuttle, and Dumbo's partner Timothy Mouse. Finally, Mickey gets Peter Pan to teach him how to fly. (With the help of Tinkerbell's pixie dust too, of course). While he teaches Donald how to fly, Peter also sings a new version of "You can Fly".

Cartoons: Mickey's Airplane Kit; Mickey and the Seagull

videos.title: Dining Goofy
videos.overview:
When touchscreen computers and headset-wearing penguins start taking over his duties, Goofy attempts to help the other staff members out, which ends in disastrous failures.

Cartoons: Answering Service; Von Drake's House of Genius (Remote Controlled Laser Lawnmower); Computer.Don

videos.title: Chip 'n' Dale
videos.overview:
Chip and Dale try to steal all the nuts in the club, and when Donald tries to stop them, Mickey and Goofy blame him for the theft. Chip and Dale finally trick Donald into flooding the club with the stolen nuts, which Mickey and Goofy mistake for a tribute to Chip and Dale.

Cartoons: Up a Tree; Goofy's Extreme Sports (Rock Climbing); Two Chips and a Miss

videos.title: Humphrey in the House
videos.overview:
Ranger J. Audubon Woodlore and the Brownstone Park Bears, including Humphrey, are hired as the club's janitors when the Magic Brooms go on vacation. Humphrey is more interested in the cuisine than work, leading to trouble.

Cartoons: Hot Tub Humphrey; Beezy Bear

videos.title: Ask Von Drake
videos.overview:
Mickey tries to prove Ludwig Von Drake wrong after he states that he knows everything.

Cartoons: Hydrosquirter; Relaxing with Von Drake

videos.title: Pluto vs. Figaro
videos.overview:
Minnie thinks that Pluto is overworked and hires Figaro to help him, but he only causes more trouble for Pluto.

Cartoons: Pluto Runs Away; Donald & the Big Nut; Pluto Gets the Paper (Street Cleaner)

videos.title: Pete's House of Villians
videos.overview:
Due to Pete's hatred of the club, Mickey lets him and the villains run the club so they can see how difficult it really is. Though Pete finds the business going well, the other villains can't hold back their evil tendencies and begin committing evil acts that makes Pete fire them. In the end, Pete sees Mickey was right.

Cartoons: L'il Bad Wolf; Donald's Dynamite (Opera Box); Organ Donors

videos.title: Halloween with Hades
videos.overview:
Hades falls in love with Maleficent, and Mickey tries to bring them together. However, all his backfiring attempts enrage Hades, whose villainous side attracts Maleficent; in a way Mickey DID succeed in helping.

Cartoons: How to Camp; Donald's Halloween Scare

videos.title: House Ghost
videos.overview:
It's Halloween, and Pete unleashes some grim, grinning ghosts onto the club to try and scare everyone away.\

Cartoons: Hansel & Gretel; Pluto Gets the Paper (UFO); How to Haunt a House

videos.title: House of Genius
videos.overview:
When things become a little slow at the House of Mouse, Von Drake creates robots that take over the House of Mouse. Much to the dismay of Mickey and the crew.

Cartoons: Futurmania; Mickey's Mechanical House

videos.title: Mickey and the Culture Clash
videos.overview:
Mickey thinks that Minnie is looking for a more sophisticated boyfriend, and Mortimer offers to help.

Cartoons: Mickey's Piano Lesson; Dance of the Goofys; Maestro Minnie (Brahms' Lullaby)

videos.title: House of Turkey
videos.overview:
Mr. Turkey is a guest at the House of Mouse and is worried that some of the guests want to eat them.

Cartoons: Turkey Catchers; Mickey's Mixed Nuts

videos.title: Clarabelle's Christmas List
videos.overview:
Clarabelle claims to have Santa's Naughty or Nice list, and adds anyone who tries to sneak a peek at it on the Naughty list.

Cartoons: Donald on Ice; Mickey's Christmas Crisis

videos.title: Pete's Christmas Caper
videos.overview:
Pete tries to steal everyone's presents when he volunteers to play Santa at the staff's Christmas party.

Cartoons: The Nutcracker; Donald's Dynamite (Snowman)

videos.title: Snow Day
videos.overview:
There's a big blizzard outside, which means that the House of Mouse is closed for the day ... until Salty the Seal shows up, looking for some entertainment.

Cartoons: Pluto's Seal Deal; Mickey's Remedy; Donald's Dynamite (Snowman)
